item.title: BTS Is Teaming Up With This Classic Cookie for a Limited Edition Flavor: ‘We Ate Them As Kids, We Eat Them In the Studio’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Get ready for a sweet surprise, ARMY. Global superstar group BTS has just unveiled their new collaboration with Oreo, and it's a game-changer. Let's dive in."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The new limited-edition BTS Oreos feature a brown sugar-pancake-flavored cookie, inspired by the hotteok street food from their childhoods in South Korea. But that's not all - the group has also designed 13 unique embossments for their cookies, honoring their 13th anniversary. And, three special cookies even spell out a message to their fans."
[Short music transition]
Host: "BTS shared their excitement about the collaboration, saying it's an honor to work with Oreo and share a taste of home with the world. The new BTS Oreos will be available for presale on June 1st and in stores on June 8th. Fans can also join in on the fun by writing digital love letters to the group, with a chance to win an exclusive prize."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This collaboration is just the latest achievement for BTS in 2026, following their grand return to the music scene with their album 'Arirang' and their ongoing world tour. Don't miss out on the chance to get your hands on these limited-edition BTS Oreos and be a part of the group's special moment with Oreo."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for now. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one."
